objective: Prevent the Workbench from submitting an object-analysis request when no non-empty OID is selected. Preserve the raw DR24 export and diagnostic QC contracts.

previous_knowledge_consumed.source: Notion Think Tank Charter & Session Register
previous_knowledge_consumed.detail: This is a focused 3–5 role engineering session. The Project Owner retains final authority; simulated specialist perspectives do not constitute external peer review.

previous_knowledge_consumed.source: Notion Park Web Demonstrator execution specification
previous_knowledge_consumed.detail: DR24 Explorer is a raw-data workflow. It must remain separate from normalized ALeRCE inference and must not trigger model inference.
runAnalysis() constructs /v1/objects/{oid}/analysis from state.oid without checking that the OID is non-empty.

The versioned ztf-dr24-raw-qc-diagnostic-v1 assessment already preserves raw epochs, separates bit-15 likely-usable from strict catflags==0 and photometry validity, and is explicitly not production-approved.

previous_knowledge_consumed.source: User-provided DR24 export and prior independent validation
previous_knowledge_consumed.detail: Two requested OIDs and 201 epochs were reported as validated in the conversation. The exact uploaded file bytes are not re-opened in this GitHub change; no new data claim is made.

change.scope: Add a client-side non-empty OID guard before issuing the object analysis request and add a Playwright regression assertion that no /analysis request is sent when the initial Workbench state has no OID. Do not change API contracts, DR24 acquisition, QC policy, raw payload, model, features, taxonomy or benchmark.
change.rationale: The browser log showed POST /v1/objects//analysis. The current runAnalysis() interpolates state.oid without validation. A client guard prevents the malformed request and gives the user an actionable status.

expected_improvement: No empty-OID analysis request is emitted from the Workbench.
The user receives a clear status message when analysis is requested without an OID.
Existing DR24 raw JSON export and diagnostic QC remain unchanged.

empty_oid_request.before: runAnalysis() can construct /v1/objects//analysis when state.oid is empty.
empty_oid_request.after: A guard returns before fetch; Playwright regression checks that no /analysis request is emitted.

raw_export_integrity.before: Existing deterministic UI test checks source payload preservation.
raw_export_integrity.after: No export implementation is changed; existing assertions remain in place.

qc_policy.before: Existing versioned diagnostic policy and unit tests are present.
qc_policy.after: No QC calculation is changed; current policy remains diagnostic only.

measurement.trade_off: The guard prevents a malformed request but does not add an OID-entry workflow. Users must select or load an object through the existing UI.

evidence: Source review confirms missing client-side OID validation in runAnalysis().
Existing QC module already distinguishes bit 15, strict clean flags and photometric validity.
Existing DR24 integration test checks raw export and source payload preservation.
validation.blocker: Run current-head Format, Lint, Lifecycle, Playwright integration, full Test Suite, Runtime Smoke, package build and Dependency Audit. Confirm test collection and inspect any skipped jobs.

root_causes: runAnalysis() did not validate state.oid before constructing the path parameter.
unresolved: The original empty-OID request's exact browser interaction sequence is not captured in a HAR; the source code path is sufficient to reproduce the malformed URL when the handler is invoked with empty state.

findings: A path parameter must be validated before constructing a request URL.
The current DR24 QC implementation already preserves raw epochs and keeps diagnostic classifications separate; do not duplicate or alter it without new evidence.

open_blockers: Run the new Playwright regression test in CI.
Run existing DR24 QC unit tests and full suite.
Run a bounded fixed OID batch after code merge in the user's local environment; this code change alone does not validate HATS data.

knowledge_carried_forward: No DR24 raw records are filtered, reordered, or modified by this change.
QC policy remains ztf-dr24-raw-qc-diagnostic-v1 and DIAGNOSTIC_NOT_PRODUCTION_APPROVED.
No production inference or v0.2.0 baseline changes are authorized or included.
